description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "I have a problem, I am working in some company in Africa where nearly all and every workers use to steal money from the highest of them to the lowest which thing makes it hard to work in such an environment. It made me more confused when I see those who practice this evil being accepted in many of our churches, SDA church, especially when they are giving their large amount of money which they get through a close deal by theft from different government projects. 
My concern is, how do I get myself from these situations?"
.
2.) Was Christ manifesting Himself in an angelic form while He was Commander of the angels? Is this why Satan thought that he could be equal to Christ? Does the Spirit of Prophecy mention this?
.
.
